notes.title: Minor Bug Fixes
notes.content: Fixed a few minor bugs with the dialogue system

notes.title: Minor Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Updated start position on certain levels
 Updated game over ui to show the shoot button

notes.title: Strawberry Interaction Bug Fix
notes.content:
Players were having issues interacting with the strawberry if they had reached the game over screen before getting to the strawberry.


Fixed the dialogue sequence. Player, even after dying, can now interact with the strawberry.

notes.title: Dialogue - Bug Fix
notes.content:
Fixed issue where after getting close to the giant strawberry, player lost control of the character.

Dialogue sequence should work properly.

notes.title: Day 0 - Bug fixes
notes.content:
Few bugs that were missed during internal testing.


 Level 4 starts at the correct spot now
 Level 3 has the correct height limit now. No grey background when jumping too high
 Score updates after level is completed and properly saves now



Please report all future bugs to undothejamdamage@gmail.com
